evidence.description: The update check reads news state directly from User.shared.

candidates.explanation: News directly accesses User.shared to read and update persisted news state. This operational dependency is obtained through a singleton rather than an explicit, replaceable dependency boundary.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: A detached task synchronously reads the file using Data(contentsOf:).
A detached task synchronously writes encoded data to disk.

candidates.explanation: The detached tasks perform synchronous file reads and writes, blocking their executing threads while waiting for filesystem I/O. Task.detached does not turn these operations into suspending asynchronous I/O.
candidates.title: Blocking Operation in Async Context
